IDENT.title: Local Decision Making based on Distributed Digital Twin Framework

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.value: DT replicates an existing physical twin, emulating behaviour in informational space and connecting physical system and virtual counterpart.
DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.evidence_quote:
replicate an existing physical twin, by emulating the 
behaviour in the informational space and offering a 
connection between the physical system and virtual 
counterpart

was developed in MatLab

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_purpos.evidence_quote:
distributed DT framework for manufacturing processes to 
carry out condition monitoring and decision making at 
equipment level.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__purpose_des.evidence_quote:
The decision making module was
